title.zh: 将卡加延省阿帕里镇阿帕里工艺贸易学校（ASAT）更名为阿帕里理工学院（API）的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Aparri School of Arts and Trade (ASAT) in Aparri, Cagayan Into the Aparri Polytechnic Institute (API)
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Aparri School of Arts and Trade (ASAT) in Aparri, Cagayan Into the Aparri Polytechnic Institute (API)
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Nghệ thuật và Thương mại Aparri tại Tỉnh Cagayan thành Học viện Aparri Polytechnic
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนศิลปะและหัตถกรรม Aparri ในจังหวัด Cagayan เป็นสถาบัน Aparri Polytechnic
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Seni dan Keterampilan Aparri di Provinsi Cagayan menjadi Institut Aparri Polytechnic
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Seni dan Pertukangan Aparri di Wilayah Cagayan kepada Institut Aparri Polytechnic

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2012/ra_10227_2012.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Renaming of School. – The name of the Aparri School of Arts and Trade (ASAT) in the Municipality of Aparri, Province of Cagayan is hereby changed to the Aparri Polytechnic Institute (API).
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
